in_sanskrit.name: कालिचरण
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who roams in time

in_marathi.name: Kalicharan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Time, Cycle, God's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalicharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kalicharan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kali' meaning time or cycle and 'Chara' meaning one who moves or one who carries. This name signifies the one who is carried by the cycle of time or the one who moves through the cycles of life with the grace of God. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often referred to as 'Kali-Ma' and the 'destroyer of cycles of time'.
